objective: Bake Rush server service: three ProximityPrompt stations, server-owned leaderstats (Coins, Tier, Pastries), and removal of the M0 RewardService so there is one owner.
acceptance_criteria: Each player gets one leaderstats folder with Coins, Tier and Pastries that update after each action
Oven, counter and upgrade prompts trigger bake, sell and upgrade on PC and mobile input
Bake attempts faster than the tier's bake time do not change Pastries
verification: Studio playtest in staging (two clients, touch and keyboard) plus QA review of the PR. Automated checks cover the rules only.
evidence: CI run https://github.com/TheAnnoyingPikachu/roblox-ai-dev/actions/runs/40113799389 (attempt 2, head c3a43e3, green). Attempt 1 failed in the rokit install step, before any code ran.
notes: In-engine behaviour is not yet verified; it needs the staging playtest.
